text:
zoe (pm): short design review follow-up: a few compliance-panel micro-nits before we flip the flag. focusing on: retention copy, region-default affordance, encryption/KMS labels, and audit export clarity.

maria (product_designer): thanks. first on audit events 1: we have mixed verbs and passive voice across events. propose we standardize to `Past-tense subject + action + object`. e.g., `marcus changed retention from 30 days to 90 days (UI)`. keeps actor first which helps scan.

miguel (frontend): prefer concise events for the table row, but full sentence for the detail drawer. Table: `Retention: 30 1 90 days by marcus (UI)` feels odd. Maybe `Retention: 30 1 90 days — marcus (UI)`.

linda (security): audit requirements: event must include actor, method (UI/API), and resource id. Suggest canonical blob: `Retention changed 30d 1 90d | actor: marcus | via: UI | resource: ws-1234`. For UI we can render a human friendly version but keep the machine-friendly fields in the JSON payload.

ethan (a11y): accessibility: when events stream in, the top of the table updates. We need an aria-live region for new critical events (polite) and ensure focus doesn't jump. Also add `aria-sort` on sortable columns and visible focus outlines for row actions.

zoe (pm): good call. next: retention labels in selects 1. current options are `30, 60, 90` which drop units. UX test participants interpreted them as minutes once. we should make visible labels `30 days`, `60 days`, `90 days`. For short displays (table) allow `30d`, `60d`, `90d`.

maria (product_designer): yeah, two i18n keys: `retention.label.compact` and `retention.label.expanded`. small code snippet for i18n keys: `retention.expanded.30 = "30 days"` and `retention.compact.30 = "30d"`. miguel can you validate shipping complexity?

miguel (frontend): trivial. will add keys and update Select component to use `aria-label="Data retention period"`. will also ensure we don't rely on visual-only text for screen readers.

kai (analytics): note: when changing retention, we should fire event `RetentionChanged` with old/new values* and `actor_type` so we can build metric for % orgs shrinking retention.

linda (security): KMS/badging 1. current table shows a small `KMS` badge which is ambiguous. proposal: replace with `Encryption: Platform key` or `Encryption: Customer key (BYOK)` rendered in two places: compact `Platform`/`BYOK` in the table; full text in details with link to docs. Also include an icon with `role="img" aria-label="Encryption: Customer-managed key"`.

maria (product_designer): for concision: table pill `Encrypted (Platform)` vs `Encrypted (BYOK)`. make BYOK color different (neutral blue) and platform green. ethan, confirm color contrast for pills.

ethan (a11y): pills must meet contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for text on background. current BYOK blue is 3.2:1. Recommend darker shade or white text on darker background. Also ensure pill has visible focus ring when keyboard tabbed.

maria (product_designer): noted. docs-bot: can you generate the tooltip copy variations we can reuse?

docs-bot: suggested tooltip (short): `Platform-managed encryption keys (default)`; `Customer-managed keys (BYOK): you manage key lifecycle`. Longer help text: `Customer-managed keys give you control over encryption keys. Deleting the key may render data unrecoverable. See key ownership docs.`

linda (security): add an explicit warning in UI when enabling BYOK: `Enabling BYOK may prevent data recovery if keys are revoked. Org admins only.` Also require a checkbox confirmation `I understand BYOK responsibilities` before saving.

maria (product_designer): okay add modal confirmation flow with checkbox. small copy for modal headline: `Enable Customer-managed key (BYOK) for workspace X?` body: `This will switch encryption to a key you manage. Deleting or removing the key may make existing data unrecoverable. Confirm you understand.` primary CTA: `Enable BYOK` secondary: `Cancel`.

miguel (frontend): will implement modal and disabled primary until checkbox checked. we'll add analytics hook `BYOKConfirmed` once checkbox checked.

zoe (pm): region defaulting 1: product asked for org-level region preference. two options: make it a visible org setting under `Organization > Defaults` or inline toggle in the flow `Make this the default for new resources`. Security prefers visible. engineering prefers minimize clutter. compromise: add inline toggle but also surface a `Learn more` link to the org defaults page.

linda (security): prefer explicit org setting but inline toggle is acceptable if it links to `Organization defaults` and shows a disclosure: `Changes affect all new resources in this org`. Also require `Org Admin` role to flip.

emotional (typo)ethan (a11y): small a11y nit: labels like `Make default` are ambiguous to screen readers. use `Make this the default region for new resources` as the aria-label.

maria (product_designer): good catch. will change label text. also change the small secondary helper to `Org default: EU (ap-south)` rather than `Regional defaults applied` so it's explicit.

zoe (pm): last item: audit CSV export. current export column: `event_text, timestamp, actor`. customers want `field_changed, from, to` columns for easy filtering. add columns `resource_id, method, notes`. miguel, can we include structured JSON blob field if the event has extra metadata?

miguel (frontend): yes we'll include `meta_json` column with stringified JSON. docs-bot: please update the export schema docs.

docs-bot: updated docs draft: `Audit export includes columns: event_type, field_changed, old_value, new_value, actor, method, resource_id, timestamp, meta_json`.

kai (analytics): flagging that including meta_json may expose PII; security to confirm before GA.

linda (security): we'll review export schema and ensure export permission gating and redaction rules apply. Exports must be `org_admin` or `compliance_officer` role. add audit event when an export is downloaded `AuditExportDownloaded` with user and filters applied.

zoe (pm): perfect. action items: maria update mockups + artboards, miguel implement i18n keys + pills + modal, kai add analytics hooks, docs-bot update docs, linda review export/redaction + BYOK modal language. i'll follow up next week for visual review. :thumbsup:
